blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Chemical Equilibrium) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are macroscopic and microscopic events? Give examples of each and explain how they are related in an equilibrium system. (4 marks)
(Macroscopic aur microscopic events kya hain? Har aik ki misalein dein aur wazahat karein ke equilibrium system mein in ka aapas mein kya taaluq hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Macroscopic events: woh waqiyat jo nangi aankh se dekhe ja sakte hain, alag alag particles ya molecules ko dekhe baghair. Misalein: rang ki tabdeeli, heat ka nikalna ya jazb hona, precipitate (tehshain) banna, gas nikalna, volume ya pressure badalna, substance ki composition badalna.

Microscopic events: woh waqiyat jo nangi aankh se nahi dekhe ja sakte. Misalein: molecules ka takrana, bonds ka tootna aur banna, molecules mein atoms ki nayi tarteeb, electrons ka kho dena ya hasil karna.

Taaluq: Macroscopic events bohat se aik saath hone wale microscopic events ka nateeja hain. Jab equilibrium mein tabdeeli aati hai to us ki wazahat karne wale microscopic events particles ke takrao aur naye bonds ka banna hain. Yeh takrao forward aur reverse reactions ke rates badalte hain, jo activation energy aur bahari factors se mutassir hote hain. Yeh sab mil kar nangi aankh se nazar aane wali macroscopic tabdeeliyan bante hain. Is liye microscopic events samajhne se macroscopic tabdeeliyon ki wazahat aur pesh goi hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Understanding the microscopic events helps us to explain and predict the observed macroscopic changes

blocks.prompt:
2 Explain, with the reaction between steam and carbon monoxide, how a state of dynamic chemical equilibrium is established. What do the concentration-time graphs show? (4 marks)
(Steam aur carbon monoxide ke reaction ki misaal se wazahat karein ke dynamic chemical equilibrium ki haalat kaise qaim hoti hai. Concentration-time graphs kya dikhate hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Reaction: H₂O(g) + CO(g) ⇌ H₂(g) + CO₂(g)

Shuru: Farz karein steam aur CO ke barabar moles milaye gaye. H₂O aur CO ke darmiyan har second takrao sab se zyada hote hain. CO aur H₂O ke bonds toot kar H₂ aur CO₂ bante hain, is liye forward reaction ka rate shuru mein sab se zyada hota hai: H₂O(g) + CO(g) → H₂(g) + CO₂(g).

Waqt ke saath: H₂O aur CO kharch hone se un ki concentration girti hai aur forward reaction sust hota hai. H₂ aur CO₂ jama hone se reverse reaction H₂(g) + CO₂(g) → H₂O(g) + CO(g) shuru hota hai; is ka rate pehle kam hota hai aur ahista ahista barhta hai.

Equilibrium: Aakhir dono reactions barabar rate se chalte hain. Mixture ki composition nahi badalti; yeh chemical equilibrium ki haalat hai. Jab tak system bigara na jaye, concentrations nahi badaltin.

Dynamic (mutaharrik) hona: Microscopic level par molecules dono taraf react karte rehte hain; sirf rates barabar hote hain. Is liye equilibrium dynamic hai, static (sakin) nahi.

Graphs (Figure 8.1, A ⇌ B): equilibrium par reactant product ke barabar, kam ya zyada ho sakta hai, lekin har soorat mein equilibrium ke baad concentrations constant ho jati hain.

book_ref.quote: Consider the reaction between steam and carbon monoxide under appropriate conditions.

blocks.prompt:
3 Explain the dynamic equilibrium between a liquid and its vapour in a closed container. How does a rise in temperature affect this equilibrium? (4 marks)
(Band bartan mein liquid aur us ki vapour ke darmiyan dynamic equilibrium ki wazahat karein. Temperature barhne ka is equilibrium par kya asar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Evaporation (bukharat): Jab liquid band bartan mein rakha jaye to surface ke qareeb kuch molecules ke paas itni energy hoti hai ke woh gas phase mein nikal jate hain. Jitne zyada molecules niklen, deewaron par vapour ka pressure utna barhta hai.

Condensation (takseef): Saath hi vapour molecules liquid surface se takra kar dobara liquid mein qaid ho jate hain.
Liquid ⇌ Gas (forward: evaporation; reverse: condensation)

Equilibrium: Dono amal jaari rehte hain aur un ke rates barabar ho jate hain; dynamic equilibrium ban jata hai. Gas phase mein jaane wale aur liquid mein wapas aane wale molecules ki tadad barabar hoti hai. Phir diye gaye temperature par vapour pressure constant rehta hai jab tak system bigara na jaye.

Temperature ka asar: Temperature barhne se molecules ki average kinetic energy barhti hai, evaporation tez hoti hai aur vapour pressure barhta hai. Condensation ka rate bhi barhta hai. Aakhir naya dynamic equilibrium zyada vapour pressure par qaim hota hai.

Mukhtasar: vapour pressure ke lihaz se dynamic equilibrium woh haalat hai jahan evaporation aur condensation ke rates barabar hon.

book_ref.quote: In short, dynamic equilibrium in terms of the vapor pressure of a liquid describes the state

blocks.prompt:
4 Under what conditions can a chemical equilibrium be established? Describe the important features of a system at chemical equilibrium, including the rule for pure solids and liquids. (4 marks)
(Chemical equilibrium kin halaat mein qaim ho sakta hai? Chemical equilibrium wale system ki ahem khususiyat bayan karein, khalis solids aur liquids ka qaida bhi.)
blocks.explanation:
Equilibrium ki sharait (8.5):
1. Equilibrium ki haalat sirf reversible reactions par laagu hoti hai.
2. Reaction ka bartan band hona chahiye; koi reactant ya product bahar na nikle (Figure 8.2: band system mein equilibrium banta hai, khule mein nahi).

Chemical equilibrium ki khususiyat (8.6):
1. Equilibrium par reactants aur products ki concentrations constant rehti hain.
2. Equilibrium tak dono taraf se pohancha ja sakta hai, chahe reactants se shuru karein ya products se.
3. Catalyst equilibrium position ya equilibrium constant nahi badalta; sirf equilibrium jaldi qaim karta hai.
4. Equilibrium constant shuru ki concentrations par munhasir nahi; yeh constant hai aur sirf temperature par munhasir hai.

Khalis solids aur liquids: Agar khalis solids ya liquids shamil hon to un ki concentrations equilibrium constant expression mein nahi likhi jatin, kyun ke un ki miqdaar badalne se equilibrium constant par asar nahi parta. Maslan CaCO₃(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO₂(g) ke liye Kc = [CO₂].

book_ref.quote: Important features of equilibrium are as follows:

blocks.prompt:
5 Define homogeneous and heterogeneous equilibrium with examples. Write the equilibrium constant expressions for the three heterogeneous equilibria given in the chapter. (4 marks)
(Homogeneous aur heterogeneous equilibrium ki definitions misalon ke saath likhein. Chapter mein diye gaye teen heterogeneous equilibria ke equilibrium constant expressions likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Reactants aur products ki physical haalat ke lihaz se chemical equilibrium ki do qismein hain.

Homogeneous (yaksaan) equilibrium: tamam reactants aur products aik hi phase mein hon. Misalein:
N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g)
2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g)
CH₃COOH(l) + C₂H₅OH(l) ⇌ CH₃COOC₂H₅(l) + H₂O(l)

Heterogeneous (ghair yaksaan) equilibrium: reactants aur products aik se zyada phases mein hon. Khalis solids Kc mein nahi likhe jate (8.6), is liye expressions yeh hain:
CaCO₃(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO₂(g); Kc = [CO₂]
C(s) + H₂O(g) ⇌ CO(g) + H₂(g); Kc = [CO][H₂]/[H₂O]
3Fe(s) + 4H₂O(g) ⇌ Fe₃O₄(s) + 4H₂(g); Kc = [H₂]⁴/[H₂O]⁴

book_ref.quote: An equilibrium in which the reactants and products are in more than one phases

blocks.prompt:
6 State the law of mass action. Derive the equilibrium constant expression for A + B ⇌ C + D and extend it to the general reaction aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD. (4 marks)
(Law of mass action bayan karein. A + B ⇌ C + D ke liye equilibrium constant expression derive karein aur isay general reaction aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD tak barhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Law of mass action: Chemical reaction ka rate reactants ke active masses ke directly proportional hai, har aik par balanced equation ka coefficient power hota hai. Active mass se muraad molar concentration (mol dm⁻³) hai, jo square brackets [ ] mein likhi jati hai.

A + B ⇌ C + D ke liye derivation:
Forward rate ∝ [A][B] = kf[A][B], kf forward rate constant hai.
Reverse rate ∝ [C][D] = kr[C][D], kr reverse rate constant hai.
Equilibrium par dono rates barabar hain:
kf[A][B] = kr[C][D]
kf/kr = [C][D]/[A][B]
Do constants ka ratio bhi constant hai, yani equilibrium constant: Kc = kf/kr
Is liye Kc = [C][D]/[A][B] (equilibrium constant expression).

General reaction aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD, jahan a, b, c aur d balanced equation ke coefficients hain:
Kc = [C]ᶜ[D]ᵈ / [A]ᵃ[B]ᵇ

Yeh Guldberg aur Waage (1864) ki daryaft se mutabiqat rakhta hai ke diye gaye halaat mein equilibrium concentrations ka yeh ratio hamesha constant hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The rate of the chemical reaction is directly proportional to the active masses of the reactants

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain with examples when the equilibrium constant Kc has units and when it has none. Work out the units of Kc for the ester formation, for ammonia synthesis and for 2N₂O₅(g) ⇌ 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g). (4 marks)
(Misalon ke saath wazahat karein ke Kc ki units kab hoti hain aur kab nahi. Ester banne, ammonia synthesis aur 2N₂O₅(g) ⇌ 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g) ke Kc ki units nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Qaida 1: Jab balanced equation mein reactants aur products ke moles barabar hon to units cancel ho jati hain aur Kc ki koi unit nahi hoti.
Ester banna: CH₃COOH(aq) + C₂H₅OH(aq) ⇌ CH₃COOC₂H₅(aq) + H₂O(l)
Kc = [CH₃COOC₂H₅][H₂O]/[CH₃COOH][C₂H₅OH] = (mol dm⁻³ × mol dm⁻³)/(mol dm⁻³ × mol dm⁻³) = koi unit nahi

Qaida 2: Jab moles barabar na hon to units cancel nahi hotin aur Kc ki unit hoti hai.
Ammonia synthesis: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g)
Kc = [NH₃]²/[N₂][H₂]³ = (mol dm⁻³)²/[(mol dm⁻³)(mol dm⁻³)³] = 1/(mol dm⁻³)² = mol⁻² dm⁶

N₂O₅ ka tootna: 2N₂O₅(g) ⇌ 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g)
Kc = [NO₂]⁴[O₂]/[N₂O₅]² = (mol dm⁻³)⁵/(mol dm⁻³)² = (mol dm⁻³)³ = mol³ dm⁻⁹

book_ref.quote: When the number of moles are unequal, then value of equilibrium constant depend upon the units

blocks.prompt:
8 Ethanoic acid and ethanol react: CH₃COOH(l) + C₂H₅OH(l) ⇌ CH₃COOC₂H₅(l) + H₂O(l). 400 cm³ of the equilibrium mixture contains 0.180 mol ethanoic acid, 0.0600 mol ethanol, 0.150 mol ethyl ethanoate and 0.150 mol water. Calculate Kc and state its units. (4 marks)
(Ethanoic acid aur ethanol react karte hain: CH₃COOH(l) + C₂H₅OH(l) ⇌ CH₃COOC₂H₅(l) + H₂O(l). 400 cm³ equilibrium mixture mein 0.180 mol ethanoic acid, 0.0600 mol ethanol, 0.150 mol ethyl ethanoate aur 0.150 mol pani hai. Kc aur us ki units nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har miqdaar ko mol dm⁻³ mein badlein (0.400 dm³ se taqseem), phir Kc = [ester][pani]/[acid][alcohol] mein qeematein rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Use this data to calculate a value of Kc for this reaction.

steps: Kc = 2.08; mol dm⁻³ ki units cancel (2 mol → 2 mol)

blocks.prompt:
9 Propanone reacts with hydrogen cyanide: CH₃COCH₃(l) + HCN(g) ⇌ CH₃C(OH)(CN)CH₃(l). A mixture of 0.0800 mol dm⁻³ propanone and 0.0800 mol dm⁻³ HCN is left to reach equilibrium. At equilibrium the concentration of the product is 0.0350 mol dm⁻³. Calculate Kc with its units. (4 marks)
(Propanone hydrogen cyanide se react karta hai: CH₃COCH₃(l) + HCN(g) ⇌ CH₃C(OH)(CN)CH₃(l). 0.0800 mol dm⁻³ propanone aur 0.0800 mol dm⁻³ HCN ka mixture equilibrium tak chhora gaya. Equilibrium par product ki concentration 0.0350 mol dm⁻³ hai. Kc units ke saath nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: 1 : 1 : 1 ratio se equilibrium par bache reactants nikalein, phir Kc mein equilibrium (shuru ki nahi) qeematein rakhein.

book_ref.quote: A mixture of 0.0500 mol dm⁻³ propanone and 0.0500 mol dm⁻³ hydrogen cyanide is left to reach equilibrium

steps: Shuru: propanone 0.0800, HCN 0.0800, product 0 mol dm⁻³
Har mol product ke liye har reactant ka 1 mol kharch hota hai, is liye har reactant 0.0350 mol dm⁻³ kam hota hai

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aam ghalti: Kc mein shuru ki concentration (0.0800) rakh dena. Hamesha equilibrium wali concentration (0.0450) istemal karein.

blocks.prompt:
10 For N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g), a vessel starts with 1.00 mol dm⁻³ N₂ and 3.00 mol dm⁻³ H₂. At equilibrium the concentration of NH₃ is 0.40 mol dm⁻³. Calculate Kc with its units. (4 marks)
(N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) ke liye bartan mein shuru mein 1.00 mol dm⁻³ N₂ aur 3.00 mol dm⁻³ H₂ hai. Equilibrium par NH₃ ki concentration 0.40 mol dm⁻³ hai. Kc units ke saath nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Equation ke 1 : 3 : 2 ratio se nikalein ke kitni N₂ aur H₂ kharch hui, phir equilibrium qeematein rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Step 1 Write out the balanced chemical equation with all the data underneath

steps: 1 mol N₂ aur 3 mol H₂ se 2 mol NH₃ banti hai; 0.40 mol dm⁻³ NH₃ ke liye 0.20 mol dm⁻³ N₂ aur 0.60 mol dm⁻³ H₂ kharch

blocks.prompt:
11 0.600 mol of CO(g) and 0.600 mol of H₂O(g) are placed in a closed 2.00 dm³ vessel and allowed to reach equilibrium: H₂O(g) + CO(g) ⇌ H₂(g) + CO₂(g). At equilibrium 0.400 mol of H₂ is present. Calculate Kc and say what Kp is. (4 marks)
(0.600 mol CO(g) aur 0.600 mol H₂O(g) band 2.00 dm³ bartan mein rakh kar equilibrium tak chhore gaye: H₂O(g) + CO(g) ⇌ H₂(g) + CO₂(g). Equilibrium par 0.400 mol H₂ mojood hai. Kc nikalein aur batayein ke Kp kitna hai.)
blocks.explanation: Tamam coefficients 1 hain, is liye kharch moles = bane moles; equilibrium concentrations nikal kar Kc. Δn = 0 se Kp = Kc.

book_ref.quote: Step 2 Calculate the equilibrium concentrations of the reactants.

steps: H₂ bani = 0.400 mol, is liye CO₂ bani = 0.400 mol aur CO kharch = H₂O kharch = 0.400 mol
Equilibrium par: CO = H₂O = 0.600 − 0.400 = 0.200 mol; H₂ = CO₂ = 0.400 mol
Concentrations (÷ 2.00 dm³): [CO] = [H₂O] = 0.100 mol dm⁻³; [H₂] = [CO₂] = 0.200 mol dm⁻³
Δn = 2 − 2 = 0, is liye Kp = Kc(RT)⁰ = Kc = 4.00

blocks.prompt:
12 For 2N₂O₅(g) ⇌ 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g) at a certain temperature the equilibrium concentrations are [N₂O₅] = 0.020 mol dm⁻³, [NO₂] = 0.040 mol dm⁻³ and [O₂] = 0.010 mol dm⁻³. Calculate Kc with its units. (4 marks)
(Kisi temperature par 2N₂O₅(g) ⇌ 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g) ki equilibrium concentrations [N₂O₅] = 0.020 mol dm⁻³, [NO₂] = 0.040 mol dm⁻³ aur [O₂] = 0.010 mol dm⁻³ hain. Kc units ke saath nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Kc likhein jis mein har concentration par us ka coefficient power ho, qeematein rakhein, aur powers se units nikalein.

book_ref.quote: When the number of moles are unequal, then value of equilibrium constant depend upon the units

steps: Units: (mol dm⁻³)⁵/(mol dm⁻³)² = (mol dm⁻³)³ = mol³ dm⁻⁹

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the four types of equilibrium constants Kc, Kp, Kn and Kx for aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD and give the relationships between them. When are they all equal? (4 marks)
(aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD ke liye chaar qisam ke equilibrium constants Kc, Kp, Kn aur Kx bayan karein aur in ke taaluqat likhein. Yeh sab kab barabar hote hain?)
blocks.explanation:
aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD ke liye:
(1) Concentrations mol dm⁻³ mein (square brackets): Kc = [C]ᶜ[D]ᵈ/[A]ᵃ[B]ᵇ
(2) Gaseous reactants aur products ke partial pressures p: Kp = pCᶜ·pDᵈ/pAᵃ·pBᵇ
(3) Moles ki tadad n: Kn = nCᶜ·nDᵈ/nAᵃ·nBᵇ
(4) Mole fractions X: Kx = XCᶜ·XDᵈ/XAᵃ·XBᵇ

Taaluqat:
Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn
Kp = Kx(P)^Δn
Kp = Kn(P/N)^Δn (har partial pressure p = (n/N) × P)
jahan R = general gas constant, T = absolute temperature, P = system ka pressure, N = reactants aur products ke kul moles, Δn = balanced equation mein (gaseous) products ke moles − reactants ke moles.

Kaun sa constant bara hai yeh Δn par munhasir hai. Jab reactants aur products ke moles barabar hon to Δn = 0 aur Kp = Kc = Kx = Kn, chahe koi bhi units istemal hon. Misaal: H₂O(g) + CO(g) ⇌ H₂(g) + CO₂(g).

book_ref.quote: There are four different types of quantities which may be used to calculate the equilibrium constants

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein Kp = Kn(N)^Δn chhapa hai jo ghalat hai; sahi relation Kp = Kn(P/N)^Δn hai kyun ke partial pressure = (n/N) × P.

blocks.prompt:
14 For N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g), Kc = 0.50 at 400 °C. Calculate Kp at this temperature (R = 0.0821 dm³ atm K⁻¹ mol⁻¹) and say whether Kp is larger or smaller than Kc. (4 marks)
(N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) ke liye 400 °C par Kc = 0.50 hai. Is temperature par Kp nikalein (R = 0.0821 dm³ atm K⁻¹ mol⁻¹) aur batayein ke Kp, Kc se bara hai ya chhota.)
blocks.explanation: °C ko K mein badlein, gas moles se Δn nikalein, phir Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn lagayein.

book_ref.quote: The formula for conversion of Kc to Kp is, Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn

steps: Δn = products ke moles − reactants ke moles = 2 − (1 + 3) = −2
Δn manfi aur RT > 1 hone se Kp, Kc se chhota hai

blocks.prompt:
15 In the reaction 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g), the equilibrium partial pressures at constant temperature are SO₂ = 2.0 × 10⁵ Pa, O₂ = 5.0 × 10⁵ Pa and SO₃ = 6.0 × 10⁵ Pa. Calculate Kp with its units. (4 marks)
(Reaction 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g) mein constant temperature par equilibrium partial pressures SO₂ = 2.0 × 10⁵ Pa, O₂ = 5.0 × 10⁵ Pa aur SO₃ = 6.0 × 10⁵ Pa hain. Kp units ke saath nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Kp mein partial pressures par coefficients ki power lagayein, qeematein rakhein, aur Pa²/Pa³ se unit nikalein.

book_ref.quote: Step 1 Write the equilibrium expression for the reaction in terms of partial pressures.

blocks.prompt:
16 For N₂O₄(g) ⇌ 2NO₂(g), Kc = 0.4 at 373 K. Calculate Kp at 373 K (R = 0.0821 dm³ atm K⁻¹ mol⁻¹). Is Kp larger or smaller than Kc? (4 marks)
(N₂O₄(g) ⇌ 2NO₂(g) ke liye 373 K par Kc = 0.4 hai. 373 K par Kp nikalein (R = 0.0821 dm³ atm K⁻¹ mol⁻¹). Kya Kp, Kc se bara hai ya chhota?)
blocks.explanation: Yahan Δn musbat hai, is liye Kp = Kc × RT aur Kp, Kc se bara aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Δn = Difference of number of moles of products and reactants in the balanced chemical equation

steps: Δn = +1 aur RT > 1 hone se Kp, Kc se bara hai

blocks.prompt:
17 At equilibrium in N₂O₄(g) ⇌ 2NO₂(g), the mole fraction of NO₂ is 0.60 and that of N₂O₄ is 0.40 at a total pressure of 2.0 atm. Calculate Kx and then Kp using Kp = Kx(P)^Δn. Check the answer from the partial pressures. (4 marks)
(N₂O₄(g) ⇌ 2NO₂(g) ke equilibrium par NO₂ ka mole fraction 0.60 aur N₂O₄ ka 0.40 hai, kul pressure 2.0 atm. Kx nikalein, phir Kp = Kx(P)^Δn se Kp. Jawab partial pressures se check karein.)
blocks.explanation: Mole fractions se Kx nikalein, Kp = Kx(P)^Δn se badlein, phir har gas ke liye p = X × P se tasdeeq karein.

book_ref.quote: When the concentrations are expressed in terms of mole fractions, (X) then

blocks.prompt:
18 What is meant by the position of equilibrium? State Le Chatelier's principle and name the factors whose effects on an equilibrium it explains. (4 marks)
(Position of equilibrium se kya muraad hai? Le Chatelier's principle bayan karein aur un factors ke naam likhein jin ke asraat ki yeh wazahat karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Position of equilibrium (8.10): equilibrium mixture mein products aur reactants ki nisbati miqdaar. Agar system bigara jaye:
• agar products ki concentration reactants ke muqable mein barhe to position daayen (products ki taraf) khisak gayi;
• agar ghate to position baayen khisak gayi.

Le Chatelier's principle (8.11): "Agar equilibrium wala system bigara jaye to woh is tarah amal karta hai ke us disturbance ka asar khatam ho jaye." Yeh batata hai ke jab koi cheez system ko waqti tor par equilibrium se hata de to kya hota hai. Yeh French chemist Henry-Louis Le Chatelier (1850-1936) ne pesh kiya.

Applications (8.11.1): yeh principle in ka asar batata hai:
1. concentration ki tabdeeli,
2. pressure (ya volume) ki tabdeeli,
3. temperature ki tabdeeli,
4. catalyst (jo equilibrium nahi khiskata lekin jaldi qaim karta hai).

Misaal: N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ mein NH₃ nikalne se equilibrium bigarta hai; system tabdeeli khatam karne ke liye zyada NH₃ banata hai, is liye position daayen khiskti hai.

book_ref.quote: Le-Chatelier’s principle describes what happens to a system when something momentarily takes it away from equilibrium.

blocks.prompt:
19 Explain the effect of a change of concentration on an equilibrium, taking the hydrolysis of BiCl₃ as an example. Write the correct Kc expression. (4 marks)
(BiCl₃ ke hydrolysis ki misaal le kar equilibrium par concentration ki tabdeeli ke asar ki wazahat karein. Sahi Kc expression likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Agar system equilibrium par ho aur koi reactant ya product daala ya nikala jaye to equilibrium position bigar jati hai. Is ki chaar soorten hain.

Reaction: BiCl₃ pani se react kar ke safaid insoluble BiOCl banata hai.
BiCl₃ + H₂O ⇌ BiOCl + 2HCl
BiOCl insoluble solid hai; pure solid Kc mein nahi likha jata, is liye
Kc = [HCl]²/[BiCl₃][H₂O]
BiCl₃ solution mein pani daalne se safaid BiOCl ke precipitate ki wajah se solution dhundla ho jata hai.

1. BiCl₃ (ya pani) daalna: equilibrium bigarta hai; zyada BiOCl aur HCl bante hain, yani reaction forward direction mein jata hai.
2. HCl daalna: zyada BiCl₃ banta hai aur reaction reverse direction mein jata hai. (Thora solid BiOCl daalne se equilibrium nahi khiskta.)
3. BiCl₃ nikalna: kami poori karne ke liye reaction reverse direction mein jata hai.
4. HCl nikalna: reaction forward direction mein jata hai. (Kuch solid BiOCl nikalna, jab ke kuch baqi ho, asar nahi karta.)

Har soorat mein nayi equilibrium position banti hai, lekin Kc constant rehta hai (temperature wohi).

book_ref.quote: Consider the following reversible reaction in which BiCl₃ reacts with water

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: solid (BiOCl) Kc mein nahi aata, is liye thora sa solid BiOCl daalne ya nikalne se equilibrium nahi khiskta; sirf HCl ya BiCl₃ ki tabdeeli use khiskati hai.

blocks.prompt:
20 Explain the effect of a change in pressure or volume on an equilibrium, taking the synthesis of ammonia as an example. When does a change of pressure have no effect? (4 marks)
(Ammonia synthesis ki misaal le kar equilibrium par pressure ya volume ki tabdeeli ke asar ki wazahat karein. Pressure ki tabdeeli ka asar kab nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation:
Asar nahi hota: Pressure ya volume ki tabdeeli ka asar laagu nahi hota jab
1. system mein koi gas shamil na ho, ya
2. gaseous reactants aur products ke moles barabar hon, n(reactants) = n(products).
Yeh asar sirf tab dekha jata hai jab n(reactants) ≠ n(products).

Misaal: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g)
Chaar moles gaseous reactants se do moles product bante hain, is liye forward reaction moles aur volume kam karta hai.

(a) Pressure barhana ya volume kam karna: Le Chatelier's principle se system kam volume wali taraf ja kar pressure kam karne ki koshish karta hai. Reaction forward direction mein khiskta hai aur zyada ammonia banti hai.

(b) Pressure kam karna ya volume barhana: reaction us taraf jata hai jo zyada volume gherti hai, is liye ammonia synthesis reverse direction mein khiskti hai.

Pressure ki tabdeeli equilibrium position badalti hai lekin Kc nahi.

book_ref.quote: In order to explain this effect, let us consider the synthesis of ammonia by Haber’s process.

blocks.prompt:
21 Explain the effect of temperature on an exothermic and an endothermic equilibrium, using the formation of SO₃ and the dissociation of N₂O₄ as examples. How does Kc change in each case? (4 marks)
(SO₃ banne aur N₂O₄ ke tootne ki misalon se exothermic aur endothermic equilibrium par temperature ke asar ki wazahat karein. Har soorat mein Kc kaise badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Temperature hi woh wahid factor hai jo Kc ki qeemat bhi badalta hai.

Exothermic reaction: 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g), ΔH° = −198 kJ
• Temperature barhana (heat dena) reverse reaction ke haq mein hai. Reaction daayen se baayen khiskta hai: [SO₃] kam, [SO₂] aur [O₂] zyada, aur Kc kam hota hai.
• Temperature kam karna (heat nikalna) forward reaction ke haq mein hai. Reaction baayen se daayen khiskta hai: [SO₃] aur Kc barhte hain. Is liye SO₃ kam temperature par zyada banti hai.
• Qeematein: Kc 298 K par 1 × 10²⁶ magar 1000 K par 2.8 × 10².

Endothermic reaction: N₂O₄(g) ⇌ 2NO₂(g), ΔH° = +57.2 kJ
• Temperature barhana forward reaction ke haq mein hai: [N₂O₄] kam, [NO₂] zyada aur Kc barhta hai; equilibrium daayen khiskta hai.
• Temperature kam karna reverse reaction aur N₂O₄ banne ke haq mein hai; equilibrium baayen khiskta hai.
• Qeematein: Kc 273 K par 7.7 × 10⁻⁵ aur 373 K par 0.4.

book_ref.quote: Le Chatelier’s Principle can be used to predict the direction of a reaction with a change in temperature.

blocks.prompt:
22 What is a catalyst? Explain the effect of a catalyst on a reversible reaction at equilibrium with the help of a potential energy diagram. (4 marks)
(Catalyst kya hai? Potential energy diagram ki madad se equilibrium par reversible reaction par catalyst ke asar ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Catalyst: woh substance jo khud kharch hue baghair chemical reaction ka rate barhata hai.

Equilibrium par asar:
• Catalyst equilibrium position ya equilibrium constant nahi badalta.
• Yeh sirf equilibrium tak pohanchne ki raftaar barhata hai, is liye reaction ki yield wohi rehti hai.

Kaise kaam karta hai (Figure 8.3): Catalyst kam activation energy wala naya raasta deta hai. Potential energy (y-axis) aur reaction coordinate (x-axis) ke graph par catalyst ki mojoodgi mein curve ki choti neechi hoti hai. Activation energy reactant level se curve ki choti tak naapi jati hai, is liye catalyst ke saath Ea kam hoti hai.

Yeh neecha raasta dono taraf kaam aata hai, is liye forward aur reverse dono reactions tez hote hain; equilibrium jaldi qaim hota hai lekin us ki position nahi badalti.

Misaal: Haber's process mein iron aur SO₃ banane mein V₂O₅ sirf rate barhane ke liye istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: A catalyst provides new path of lower activation energy for a reaction.

blocks.prompt:
23 Describe how the principles of chemical equilibrium are applied to obtain the maximum yield of ammonia in Haber's process. Give the optimum conditions with reasons. (4 marks)
(Bayan karein ke Haber's process mein ammonia ki zyada se zyada yield ke liye chemical equilibrium ke usool kaise laagu kiye jate hain. Munasib tareen halaat wajah ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Reaction: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g); ΔH = −92.2 kJ (fi mol NH₃ −46.11 kJ). Reaction reversible aur exothermic hai.

Zyada yield ke tareeqe (Le Chatelier's principle):
1. Concentration: ammonia ko waqtan fawaqtan bartan se nikalein; equilibrium forward direction mein khiskta hai.
2. Pressure: chaar moles reactants se do moles products bante hain, yani volume kam hota hai; zyada pressure equilibrium ko daayen khiskata hai.
3. Temperature: reaction exothermic hai, is liye kam temperature isay aage khiskata hai. Table 8.1 mein Kc 200 K par 7.15 × 10¹⁵ se 800 K par 3.96 × 10⁻² tak girta hai. Sab se mukammal tabdeeli 98.3% hai, 473 K (200 °C) aur 1000 atm par.

Darmiyani raah: 200 °C par yield achhi hai lekin rate bohat sust hai aur process ghair munafa bakhsh. Is liye temperature darmiyana 400 °C rakha jata hai aur rate barhane ke liye catalyst istemal hota hai. Catalyst ke baghair wohi rate bohat zyada temperature mangta jo yield kam kar deta.

Munasib tareen halaat:
• Pressure: 200-300 atm
• Temperature: taqreeban 673 K (400 °C)
• Catalyst: MgO, Al₂O₃ aur SiO₂ ke pighle mixture mein iron crystals ke tukre

book_ref.quote: We can apply the concept of equilibrium in order to have the maximum yield from the industrial synthesis of ammonia.

blocks.prompt:
24 Describe the application of chemical equilibrium to the preparation of sulphur trioxide. Use Table 8.2 to explain the choice of conditions. (4 marks)
(Sulphur trioxide ki tayyari mein chemical equilibrium ke istemal ko bayan karein. Halaat ke intikhab ki wazahat Table 8.2 se karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Reaction: H₂SO₄ banane ke liye SO₂ aur O₂ se reversible aur exothermic process mein SO₃ banayi jati hai:
2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g); ΔH = −197.9 kJ mol⁻¹

Le Chatelier's principle: gas ke 3 moles se 2 moles bante hain aur reaction exothermic hai, is liye SO₃ ki behtar yield ke liye zyada pressure aur kam temperature chahiye.

Rate ba muqabla yield: Kam temperature par SO₃ ka Kc bara hai lekin equilibrium bohat ahista banta hai. Temperature barhane se rate barhta hai lekin SO₃ ki yield girti hai. Table 8.2 (1 atm par) yeh dikhata hai:
200 °C: Kc 5500, 98% SO₃; 400 °C: Kc 160, 75%; 600 °C: Kc 25, 46%; 700 °C: Kc 13, 31%.

Sanati halaat: Munasib waqt mein achhi yield ke liye SO₂ aur O₂ (hawa) ka mixture 1 atm par V₂O₅ jaise solid catalyst par se guzara jata hai. Reaction exothermic hone se gas ka temperature taqreeban 600 °C tak barh jata hai, is liye equilibrium mixture ko 400-500 °C ke kam temperature par recycle kiya jata hai taake SO₃ ki yield barhe.

book_ref.quote: To manufacture H₂SO₄, sulphur trioxide gas is produced from SO₂ and O₂
